build_dictionary: build a word dictionary from a reddit folder with special tokens and a max word limit
build_bert_dictionary: build a BERT tokenizer dictionary from pretrained bert-base-cased with fastText token mappings
TrainEnvironment_build_train_dataloader: build a PyTorch DataLoader for training on the empchat or reddit dataset for a given epoch
TrainEnvironment_build_valid_dataloader: build a PyTorch DataLoader for validation or testing on dailydialog, empchat, or reddit datasets
pad: pad a list of 1D or 2D PyTorch tensors to uniform size with a specified padding value
